notablePrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
description:
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating a Clue, a Food and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two of the tokens, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.
